---
title: "Try the Era Classifier"
toc: false
---

Paste any block of song lyrics and the classifier will predict which decade they sound like they're from **1980s through 2020s**.

The model running here is **XGBoost (Full)**, the best-performing configuration from the modeling analysis: trained on 384-dimensional lyrical embeddings plus 5 engineered features (word count, sentiment, rhyme density, repetition ratio, and language), with no PCA reduction. It achieves a macro-averaged F1 of 0.538 on the held-out test set, well above the 0.20 random-chance baseline.

On first use, two files are downloaded and cached by your browser: the sentence embedding model (~22 MB) and the XGBoost tree structure. Subsequent clicks are instant.

```{=html}
<div id="era-widget" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; padding:1.4rem; margin:1.5rem 0; background:#fafafa;">

  <p style="margin:0 0 0.6rem; font-weight:600;">Paste song lyrics here:</p>

  <textarea id="lyrics-input" rows="10"
    style="width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; font-size:0.9rem; padding:0.5rem;
           border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; resize:vertical; font-family:inherit;"
    placeholder="e.g. I was running through the jungle on a moonlit night..."></textarea>

  <div style="margin-top:0.8rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap;">
    <button id="classify-btn" onclick="classifyLyrics()"
      style="background:#4e79a7; color:white; border:none; border-radius:5px;
             padding:0.5rem 1.4rem; font-size:0.95rem; cursor:pointer;">
      Classify Era
    </button>
    <span id="status-msg" style="font-size:0.88rem; color:#555;"></span>
  </div>

  <div id="chart-container" style="display:none; margin-top:1.4rem;">
    <p id="pred-headline" style="font-weight:600; font-size:1.1rem; margin:0 0 0.6rem;"></p>
    <div id="bar-chart"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script type="module">
let extractor = null, scalerData = null, xgbData = null, modelsLoaded = false;

function setStatus(msg) {
  document.getElementById("status-msg").textContent = msg;
}

function softmax(arr) {
  const m = Math.max(...arr);
  const e = arr.map(v => Math.exp(v - m));
  const s = e.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  return e.map(v => v / s);
}

function renderBars(classes, probs) {
  const predIdx = probs.indexOf(Math.max(...probs));
  document.getElementById("pred-headline").textContent =
    `Predicted Era: ${classes[predIdx]}  (${(probs[predIdx]*100).toFixed(1)}% confidence)`;

  const colors = ["#66c2a5","#fc8d62","#8da0cb","#e78ac3","#a6d854"];
  const html = classes.map((cls, i) => `
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;margin:6px 0;gap:8px;">
      <span style="width:52px;text-align:right;font-size:0.88rem;flex-shrink:0;">${cls}</span>
      <div style="flex:1;background:#eee;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;height:24px;">
        <div style="width:${(probs[i]*100).toFixed(1)}%;background:${colors[i]};
                    height:100%;border-radius:4px;transition:width 0.5s;"></div>
      </div>
      <span style="width:48px;font-size:0.88rem;">${(probs[i]*100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
    </div>`).join("");

  document.getElementById("bar-chart").innerHTML = html;
  document.getElementById("chart-container").style.display = "block";
}

function predictXGB(scaledFeatures, xgb) {
  const { f, t, l, r, o, n_classes } = xgb;
  const margins = new Array(n_classes).fill(0);
  const n_trees = o.length - 1;
  for (let tree = 0; tree < n_trees; tree++) {
    let node = o[tree];
    while (f[node] !== -1) {
      node = scaledFeatures[f[node]] < t[node] ? l[node] : r[node];
    }
    margins[tree % n_classes] += t[node];
  }
  return softmax(margins);
}

async function ensureModels() {
  if (modelsLoaded) return;
  setStatus("Loading sentence encoder (first-time download ~22 MB)…");

  const { pipeline } =
    await import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@xenova/transformers@2.17.2");
  extractor = await pipeline("feature-extraction", "Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2",
                              { quantized: true });

  setStatus("Loading XGBoost model…");
  const base = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/[^/]*$/, "");
  const [sRes, xRes] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(`${base}/models/pca_export.json`),
    fetch(`${base}/models/xgb_export.json`),
  ]);
  scalerData = await sRes.json();
  xgbData    = await xRes.json();

  modelsLoaded = true;
  setStatus("");
}

window.classifyLyrics = async function () {
  const text = document.getElementById("lyrics-input").value.trim();
  if (!text) { setStatus("Please paste some lyrics first."); return; }

  document.getElementById("classify-btn").disabled = true;
  try {
    await ensureModels();
    setStatus("Encoding lyrics…");

    const out = await extractor(text, { pooling: "mean", normalize: true });
    const emb = Array.from(out.data);  // 384 floats

    const em = scalerData.extra_feature_means;
    const full = [...emb,
      em.lyric_word_count, em.sentiment,
      em.rhyme_density, em.repetition_ratio, em.is_english,
    ];  // 389 floats

    const scaled = full.map((v, i) =>
      (v - scalerData.mean[i]) / (scalerData.scale[i] || 1));

    setStatus("Running classifier…");
    const probs = predictXGB(scaled, xgbData);

    setStatus("");
    renderBars(xgbData.classes, probs);
  } catch (err) {
    setStatus(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    console.error(err);
  } finally {
    document.getElementById("classify-btn").disabled = false;
  }
};
</script>
```

---

*For the full modeling pipeline: feature engineering, training, SHAP analysis, and UMAP projections, see the [Model Implementation](era-classifier.qmd) page.*
